assumption_statement: Hazard perception lags actual risk by 1-3 years
Program funding can constrain implementation rate
Equity interventions can reduce community opposition
Soft index variables are best represented as 4-level ordinal scales tied to observable criteria rather than arbitrary continuous indices
validation_plan: Stakeholder review of level definitions for face validity
notes: Integer levels 0-3; definitions in models/ordinal_scale_definitions.csv; model equations use lookup tables to translate levels into effects
